title: The Hollow of Ashvale Revisited
author: S. M. Crane
blurb: Elodie Fairweather, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
